sources.title: GAO-18-559: Actions Taken by Equifax and Federal Agencies, August 2018
sources.supports: Highlights and methodology: four factors, agency response and explicit dependence on Equifax investigation.

sources.title: FTC complaint against Equifax, July 22, 2019
sources.supports: Paragraphs 14–22: patch notice, scan scope, network segmentation and credentials. Allegations, not judicial factual findings.

sources.title: House Oversight Committee Republican staff report announcement, December 10, 2018
sources.supports: Key findings: accountability gap, legacy complexity, certificate maintenance, consumer support. Announcement inspected; full staff report not claimed.

sources.title: Equifax stipulated court order, July 23, 2019
sources.supports: Findings paragraph 3; affected-consumer definition; section II A–E, printed pages 2 and 12–15. Obligations not proof of compliance.

sources.title: FTC Equifax case docket
sources.supports: Case summary and dated complaint/order entries; global settlement range, not consumer payout per person.

coverage: Selected official source passages and summaries, not every page of each report. FTC news release timed out; case docket and signed order were inspected instead.
source_budget_note: Each cited source contributes fewer than 200 words of paraphrase; no direct quotations.
